articles.summary: Open a conversation in the Admin Portal and the vehicle cards, bookings, pre-qualification results and contact forms the buyer saw in web chat sit in the transcript. A message sent from a nudge is marked as sent automatically.
articles.title: See What the Buyer Saw

articles.summary: Press Cmd+K (Ctrl+K on Windows) from any page in the Admin Portal to search orders, leads, conversations, inventory and preorders at once, plus every page and settings section. Results are ranked by relevance, and the records you opened last are one keystroke away.
articles.title: Find Anything From Anywhere in the Admin Portal

articles.summary: When a lead needs a person, the AI Sales Agent texts the rep who owns it. A reply of a few words answers a buyer's question or puts a hot lead in the rep's hands to call, so it is even easier to turn leads into buyers.
articles.title: Act on Leads in Seconds, From Your Phone
